column1: Daily Weather Observations for Pearce RAAF Base, Western Australia for January 2023
Prepared at 13:03 UTC on Monday  5 June 2023   IDCJDW6108.202301
Most observations from Pearce RAAF Base, but some from Perth Airport.

The mean sea level pressure at Perth Airport is provided for convenience. On most occasions it will be within 1 hPa of that at Pearce.Some cloud observations are from automated equipment; these are somewhat different to those made by a human observer and may not appear every day.
Temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, cloud and rainfall observations are from Pearce RAAF {station 009053}
Sunshine observations are from Perth Airport {station 009021}
